info.title: BaseLinker API
info.description: API for exchanging information between an external system and BaseLinker. Communication in JSON format. Each request requires a token (X-BLToken header). Rate limit: 100 requests per minute. Encoding: UTF-8. Method documentation: docs/methods/ directory.

post.description:
Invoke any API method. Pass the `method` field (method name) and `parameters` (JSON object with arguments). In practice, the request is sent as application/x-www-form-urlencoded: method=method_name&parameters=URL_ENCODED_JSON. Parameter and response details for each method: docs/methods/<method>.md.

**Response models:** Typed *Response schemas are defined in components/schemas (e.g. GetOrdersResponse, AddOrderResponse) — OpenAPI Generator creates separate classes from them. The endpoint returns a generic ConnectorResponse; in your client after calling the API you can deserialize the JSON to the proper type (e.g. ObjectMapper.readValue(json, GetOrdersResponse.class)) based on the method sent.

200.description: API response. Always JSON with a `status` field: SUCCESS or ERROR. On ERROR, `error_message` and `error_code` are also returned. Remaining fields depend on the method.

blToken.name: X-BLToken
blToken.description: API token from the BaseLinker panel: Account & other -> My account -> API

parameters.description: Method arguments in JSON format (for application/x-www-form-urlencoded — pass as string, e.g. JSON.stringify(obj))
Method arguments. Fields depend on the chosen method — details in docs/methods/<method>.md

ConnectorResponse.description: Generic API response. For typed models use *Response schemas below — the generator creates separate classes (GetOrdersResponse, AddOrderResponse, etc.); in your client you can deserialize the response to the proper type after calling.

ApiResponseBase.description: Base fields of every API response
